audit_items.proof_trace: No NEXT_PUBLIC_* env var embeds any OAuth secret (Grep confirms zero matches), and no hardcoded client_secret literal exists in any source file, so no secret value can appear in a Next.js client bundle. The plaintext client_secret is generated server-side at runtime, held in a server-scoped variable, and returned once in an admin-gated API response (line 68); it never participates in build-time bundle compilation. The one-time display in OAuthClientForm.tsx ('use client') is intentional admin UX, not static bundle exposure.
